content: ConvoKit's Corpus.load() requires 5 files: utterances.jsonl, speakers.json, conversations.json, corpus.json, and index.json — the last two (corpus-level metadata + a metadata-type index) are generated by ConvoKit's own dump() method and are NOT part of the raw supreme-corpus download the project already has. Since D-20/D-21 only copies utterances.jsonl/conversations.json/speakers.json (plus non-ConvoKit cases.jsonl and a CSV), the convokit Corpus loader cannot be used as-is without fabricating corpus.json/index.json. Recommendation: parse the 3 ConvoKit JSON/JSONL files directly with stdlib json, bypass the convokit pip package entirely.
